messages.content: Calculate the final temperature when 2 moles of gas at 300 K are mixed with 3 moles of the same gas at 400 K.

function.name: calculate_final_temperature
function.description: Calculate the final temperature when different quantities of the same gas at different temperatures are mixed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

quantity1.description: The quantity of the first sample of gas.

temperature1.description: The temperature of the first sample of gas.

quantity2.description: The quantity of the second sample of gas.

temperature2.description: The temperature of the second sample of gas.

function.name: calculate_mass
function.description: Calculate the mass of a gas given its quantity and molar mass. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

molar_mass.description: The molar mass of the gas.

message.reasoning: We need to compute final temperature when mixing gases of same type, same specific heat capacity? For ideal gas, internal energy U = n * Cv * T. For mixing, total internal energy conserved (no heat exchange). So final T = (n1*T1 + n2*T2)/(n1+n2). So (2*300 + 3*400)/5 = (600 + 1200)/5 = 1800/5 = 360 K. So answer: 360 K.
